channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE mantém decisão que cassou mandato de Denarium, ex-governador de RR
item.description: The TSE confirmed the cassation of the mandates of former Roraima governor Antonio Denarium and former vice-governor Edilson Damião due to abuse of power during the 2022 campaign, including irregular distribution of basic food baskets and housing repair aid. The unanimous decision rejected the defense's appeal, upholding their ineligibility and ordering new elections in the state.

item.title: Fux comandará Turma do STF responsável por processo do Master
item.description: Minister Luiz Fux will assume the presidency of the STF's 2nd Chamber in August, replacing Gilmar Mendes, and defended ministers' independence in voting. The chamber handles high-impact cases, including the Master Bank case and the debate on private contracts replacing public deeds in real estate. The change is administrative and does not affect case rapporteurs or outcomes.

item.title: TSE suspende prazo sobre diplomação para governador na eleição suplementar de Roraima
item.description: The TSE suspended the judgment of appeals regarding the candidacy registrations of Arthur Henrique and Subtenente Veltom in the supplementary election for governor of Roraima, awaiting a definitive ruling from the STF on the disqualification deadline. It also suspended the regional calendar deadline for the certification of elected officials. The decision was unanimous, with Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira emphasizing the need to await the STF to avoid contradictory legal pronouncements.

item.title: TSE nega recursos e mantém cassação de governador de Roraima
item.description: The TSE upheld the removal of former Roraima governor Antônio Denarium and former vice-governor Edilson Damião for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections, confirming their eight-year ineligibility. Despite Denarium’s resignation to run for Senate, the TSE ordered new direct elections held on June 21, where Arthur Henrique (PL) won 60.87% of valid votes, although his candidacy was later rejected by Roraima’s Electoral Justice, leaving the final outcome to be decided by the TSE.

item.title: TSE vai esperar decisão do Supremo sobre eleição suplementar de RR
item.description: The TSE decided to await the STF's final ruling on the validity of the 2026 supplementary election calendar before certifying Arthur Henrique's (PL) victory in Roraima, which occurred under sub judice conditions following the removal of Governor Antonio Denarium. Although rapporteur Antonio Carlos Ferreira acknowledged jurisprudence permitting shortened incompatibilization periods in supplementary elections, he urged institutional prudence in deferring to the STF, given ongoing challenges to the calendar, including cases from other states.

item.title: Valdemar justifica ‘momento difícil’ para saída de Michelle do PL Mulher
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro resigns as national president of PL Women amid a 'difficult moment' cited by Valdemar Costa Neto, choosing to focus full-time on caring for jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro and addressing family tensions. Her departure follows a public video accusation against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for mistreatment, intensifying internal strife within the Bolsonaro clan.

item.title: Motta agradece a Lula e diz que Plano Safra ajuda produtores de cana
item.description: House President Hugo Motta thanked President Lula for the 2026/2027 Harvest Plan, stating it will aid 17,000 independent sugarcane producers in the Northeast impacted by U.S. tariffs, falling domestic sugar prices, and rising input costs. The plan allocates R$ 97.3 billion for family farming, including rural credit, agricultural insurance, and technical assistance.

item.title: TSE mantém diploma de deputado federal de Rondônia
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously upheld the diploma of federal deputy Rafael Bento Pereira, known as Rafael Fera, rejecting a challenge by the Electoral Public Ministry alleging ineligibility due to loss of his municipal mandate for breach of parliamentary decorum. The rapporteur, Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira, ruled that ineligibility can only be based on facts occurring before the final candidate registration deadline for the 2022 elections, and the decree causing the loss of his mandate was issued after that deadline, making it ineligible to contest the diploma.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro deixa PL Mulher em meio a crise com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro announced her resignation as national president of PL Mulher following internal conflicts with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, over party alliances, particularly the PL’s alignment with Ciro Gomes in Ceará. Despite stepping down, the Liberal Party still views her as a potential Senate candidate for the Federal District, and her decision was made after a meeting with Valdemar Costa Neto and reflection with Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest.

item.title: “Melhor arma que um país pode ter é alimento”, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended food sovereignty as a country's 'best weapon' during the launch of the 2026/2027 Harvest Plan, announcing R$ 97.7 billion in credit for family farmers. He emphasized diversified food production, reduced rural credit interest rates, and the use of Union-held lands to strengthen family agriculture, referencing his conversation with Hugo Chávez on the need for food independence.

item.title: “Os maiores inimigos do Brasil são os políticos do Nordeste”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, a pre-candidate for Presidency from Missão, stated that Brazil's biggest enemies are politicians from the Northeast, during a speech in Porto Alegre about the federal pact. He criticized the distribution of resources between the Union, states, and municipalities, blaming national problems on the region. The remark sparked controversy and was first published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Valdemar: Michelle deixou PL Mulher para concentrar atividades em cuidar do nosso presidente
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the Liberal Party (PL), stated that Michelle Bolsonaro left PL Mulher to focus on caring for former president Jair Bolsonaro. He described the decision as natural and acknowledged growing divisions within the party as expected. The remarks were made following a meeting in Brasília on Tuesday, the 30th.

item.title: Lula brinca com jogo Brasil x Japão e agradece publicamente Ancelotti
item.description: Lula joked about Brazil's 2-1 win over Japan during the launch of the Plano Safra/2026/27, praising Casemiro's goal and publicly thanking Carlo Ancelotti for not substituting the Brazilian midfielder. The event took place at the Palácio do Planalto on Tuesday, June 30.

item.title: PT tenta atrair eleitorado católico
item.description: The PT will release on Wednesday, May 1st, a letter addressed to Catholics, drafted following a Tuesday night meeting on April 30th, as part of a strategy to attract religious voters, similar to the approach taken on June 8th with evangelicals. The text focuses on faith and values but explicitly excludes the abortion issue, aiming to broaden Catholic support in Lula’s re-election bid.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral alinha estratégias de TI e segurança para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) convened IT secretaries from all 27 Regional Electoral Courts (TREs) to align technology and security strategies for the 2026 General Elections. The meeting focused on refining risk mitigation and contingency plans, covering cyberattack prevention, logistical and electronic security, network infrastructure, and rapid response to operational incidents.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil fará "tudo ao alcance" para ajudar Venezuela
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil will do "everything within its reach" to assist Venezuela following earthquakes that left nearly 2,000 dead. He announced the deployment of Brazilian Air Force aircraft carrying rescue teams, health professionals, and humanitarian aid, and emphasized a ministerial delegation led by Defense Minister José Múcio to coordinate relief and reconstruction efforts.

item.title: Atos de sindicatos pelo país pedem o fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: Workers from 15 states and the Federal District held protests on Tuesday (June 30, 2026) demanding the end of the 6x1 work scale and approval of PEC 221/2019 in the Senate, which would reduce the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours. The movement, led by unions including CUT, Frentes Brasil Popular and VAT, had modest turnout in Brasília (around 200 people), with speeches by Agnelo Queiroz and Leandro Grass criticizing the elite and advocating for workers’ rest and health.

item.title: Lula aposta em vitória do Brasil por 3x0 contra Noruega e agradece Ancelotti por ter mantido Casemiro em campo contra o Japão
item.description: President Lula predicted Brazil will defeat Norway 3-0 in the 2026 World Cup round of 16, set for July 5 in New Jersey. He also praised coach Carlo Ancelotti for keeping Casemiro on the field during the match against Japan, noting the midfielder’s goal after early criticism. Lula emphasized that trusting Ancelotti’s judgment paid off despite initial doubts.

item.title: Entre Trump e a eleição, Lula envia recado duplo no Mercosul
item.description: Lula used the Mercosul summit to deliver a dual message: internationally, he advocated for regional autonomy and rejected automatic alignment with the U.S. under Trump; domestically, he leveraged the defense of Pix as a symbol of technological sovereignty to strengthen his internal political narrative and lay the groundwork for electoral battles, contrasting himself with opponents seen as more aligned with Washington.

item.title: Frente parlamentar do agro critica ausência de Lula em lançamento do Plano Safra: ‘Preocupante’
item.description: The Parliamentary Agricultural Front criticized President Lula's absence from the launch of the 2026/2027 Harvest Plan for agribusiness, calling it 'the most concerning'. The caucus argues that the absence reinforces an erroneous government attempt to divide the agricultural sector, as Lula only attended the announcement for family farming. The FPA also criticized the plan's measures as insufficient to address sector indebtedness and credit restrictions.

item.title: O que é o PL Mulher? Entenda grupo do qual Michelle Bolsonaro fazia parte
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro resigned as national president of PL Mulher following a public dispute with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating she will now focus fully on her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, and their daughter. She noted that during her tenure (2023–2024), she built the organization from scratch into Brazil’s largest partisan women’s political movement, electing 1,005 female candidates in 2024 — a 45.8% increase from 2020. PL Mulher is the women’s wing of the Liberal Party, aiming to encourage women’s political participation and support female officeholders through guides rooted in family, education, and human dignity.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro anuncia saída do comando do PL Mulher após desavença com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro announced her resignation as president of PL Mulher following a disagreement with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating she needed to focus fully on caring for her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, and their daughter. The decision came after a meeting with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto and was accompanied by her public criticism of the party's support for Ciro Gomes in Ceará over Eduardo Girão, sparking a familial and political rift within Bolsonarismo.

item.title: Alcolumbre reafirma apoio a Jaques Wagner
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre reaffirmed his support for Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) after Wagner was targeted in the PF’s Operation Compliance Zero, expressing confidence in Wagner’s innocence and criticizing the judiciary for premature condemnations. Alcolumbre also praised the new Senate Government Leader, Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), highlighting her articulation skills and pledging full support for her agenda. Wagner stepped down as government leader on June 25 following search and seizure warrants executed on June 18, tied to the Banco Master investigation.

item.title: 'Michelle passa por um momento difícil', diz presidente do PL após reunião com ex-primeira-dama
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro announced her resignation as national president of PL Mulher, stating she will focus entirely on caring for her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, and their daughter during a difficult family period. The decision followed a public rift with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, after a video surfaced in which Michelle accused him of mistreatment and humiliation. PL President Valdemar Costa Neto said he respects her choice and praised her leadership of the party's women's wing.

item.title: Após desavença com Flávio, Michelle deixa presidência do PL Mulher
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro announced her resignation as president of PL Mulher following a public disagreement with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, her stepson and pre-candidate for President. She has not yet clarified whether she will maintain or withdraw her Senate candidacy in the Federal District. The move signals a visible rift within the Bolsonaro family and the PL party.

item.title: PT divulgará carta a católicos e deixará aborto fora de manifesto, diz coordenador do partido
item.description: The PT will release a letter targeting Catholics, following a similar approach previously used with evangelicals, to bolster Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election campaign. The document will address issues of interest to the faithful but will exclude abortion from the party’s platform, as stated by the party coordinator. The initiative aims to broaden religious support without engaging in divisive controversies.

item.title: Governo Lula nega impacto nos juros e impõe bloqueio maior a bets em novo Desenrola
item.description: President Lula launched a new phase of the Desenrola program, Desenrola Adimplentes, targeting informal workers with current accounts, offering debt renegotiation at up to 1.99% monthly interest and a six-month CPF block on betting platforms as a condition. The government also introduced Fies Empreendedor, providing loans at 11% annual interest to graduates who have been current for at least 36 months, with limits of R$ 80,000 for individuals and R$ 180,000 for legal entities. The Treasury estimates a R$ 4 billion cost with no primary impact, and Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated the measures will not affect monetary policy.

item.title: Kim diz que crise dos Bolsonaros pode impulsionar Renan Santos
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) stated that the crisis involving Michelle Bolsonaro, Flávio Bolsonaro, and the PL leadership could benefit pre-candidate Renan Santos, an MBL founder. He argued that the wear and tear on the Bolsonaro family tends to favor Renan in the 2026 election race. The comment was made in an interview with O Antagonista.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz a aliados que não desistiu de candidatura
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro resigned as president of PL Mulher to focus on caring for her husband and daughter, but did not rule out a future Senate candidacy. She stated the moment belongs to her husband and that she wishes to avoid confusion with her son Flávio Bolsonaro, with whom she had political disagreements over the party's strategy in Ceará. Although she said she felt humiliated and disrespected by him, Michelle denied having abandoned her pre-candidacy.

item.title: Michelle deixa presidência do PL Mulher após atrito com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro resigned as president of PL Mulher on June 30, 2026, following a dispute with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision was made in a meeting with Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, and justified as a full dedication to her family. The conflict arose after Michelle accused Flávio of humiliating and mistreating her over the phone in a viral video, although he later apologized and tensions were partially eased.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro deixa presidência do PL Mulher e diz que vai se dedicar integralmente à família
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro announced she will step down as president of PL Mulher to focus full-time on caring for her husband, former president Jair Bolsonaro, and their minor daughter. The decision follows a meeting with PL leader Valdemar da Costa Neto and comes amid family tensions with her stepsons Flávio, Eduardo, and Carlos Bolsonaro, after she posted a video accusing Flávio of mistreatment. Although she had been considered a potential Senate candidate for the Federal District, her use of 'fully' in the statement implies the candidacy is currently off the table.

item.title: Lula e Rodrigo Paz, da Bolívia, avançam em acordo para exploração de gás
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced that Brazil and Bolivia have advanced talks to accelerate natural gas exploration agreements between Petrobras and YPFB, with technical meetings scheduled for this week. The meeting also addressed Bolivia’s political crisis, with Lula reaffirming Brazil’s support for democracy and humanitarian aid. Held during the Mercosul summit in Asunción, Lula defended the bloc’s autonomy and rejected automatic alignments.

item.title: A reclamação de Alcolumbre sobre pressão para pautar o fim da jornada 6×1
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) complained about pressure from an 'important Brazilian authority' to vote on the PEC ending the 6×1 workweek before the 2026 elections, calling it a threat. Minister Guilherme Boulos (PSOL) criticized Alcolumbre for blocking the proposal, already approved by the Chamber, stating the government will insist on its Senate vote before the election.

item.title: Alcolumbre atende governo e retarda votação de pauta-bomba bilionária
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre postponed the vote on PEC 14/2021, which establishes special retirement for health agents and bans outsourcing, following a meeting with the Lula government. The proposal carries an estimated fiscal impact of R$ 30 billion over 10 years, which Alcolumbre rejected as unfairly labeled a 'budget bomb,' noting that other fiscally impactful measures have also been advanced.

item.title: Cotado para ser candidato do PSD a vice-presidente, Kassab diz que decisão cabe a Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, stated that the choice of vice president on the party's presidential ticket rests with pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado, who will announce the name this Wednesday (1st) in Brasília. Although Kassab is being considered for the role, he emphasized that the decision belongs to the ticket's head. Caiado highlighted the importance of the vice presidency and noted there is near-consensus within the party base on the selection.

item.title: Lula diz que Pix pode servir de modelo para criação de sistema de pagamentos no Mercosul
item.description: President Lula advocated during the Mercosul Summit for financial integration in the bloc, suggesting that Pix could serve as a model for a regional payment system. He also emphasized the need for police, judicial, and financial cooperation to combat transnational organized crime and stated he will run for re-election in 2026 to safeguard democracy in Brazil.

item.title: Brasil ajudará Venezuela “no curto e no médio prazo”, diz Múcio
item.description: Brazilian Defense Minister José Múcio announced that Brazil is prepared to assist Venezuela in the short and medium term following two earthquakes that struck Caracas and La Guaira last week, killing at least 1,900 people and leaving tens of thousands missing. Brazil has already deployed humanitarian aid, including rescue teams and medical supplies, with approximately 100 military personnel operating in the disaster zone.

item.title: Wajngarten defende fim de “ruídos” entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lawyer Fabio Wajngarten urged an end to tensions between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that everyone is in a period of sacrifice and must work together. He emphasized the need to strengthen female voter support in Flávio’s ticket, suggesting a female running mate should be chosen based on electoral data, and said Senator Damares Alves should do more to help attract women voters.

item.title: Exclusivo: Michelle vai ao encontro de Damares após reunião com Valdemar no PL
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro met with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto at the party's headquarters in Brasília, followed by a private meeting with Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF). The information was obtained exclusively by O Antagonista through sources close to both figures.

item.title: Chapa Caiado-Kassab é símbolo do fracasso da direita alternativa
item.description: The PSD officially announced Gilberto Kassab as the vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket for the 2026 elections, in an event held in Brasília. The pairing is characterized as a symbol of the failure of the alternative right, reflecting criticism of the party's political strategy.

item.title: Alcolumbre adia votação de PEC considerada pauta-bomba pelo governo Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre postponed the vote on a PEC establishing special retirement rules for community health agents and endemic disease combat workers, which the Lula government considers a 'budget bomb' due to its estimated fiscal impact of up to 54 billion reais over ten years. Alcolumbre cited personal offenses and attacks as the reason for the delay, stating that the Senate's deliberation environment is not normal.

item.title: Lula anuncia Plano Safra da agricultura familiar com R$ 85 bilhões em crédito
item.description: President Lula announced the Family Agriculture Harvest Plan for the 2026/2027 crop with R$ 85.2 billion in credit, the highest volume in history, surpassing the R$ 78.2 billion from the previous harvest. The program includes interest rate reductions to as low as 1% for organic production and 2% for other lines, along with complementary measures such as agricultural insurance, public procurement, and technical assistance. The total investment, including these additional actions, is expected to reach R$ 97.3 billion.

item.title: Mendonça pede parecer da PGR sobre pedido de investigação no caso ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça requested an opinion from the Attorney General’s Office (PGR) regarding a petition to include Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro in the 'Dark Horse' investigation, which examines alleged illegal funding for Eduardo Bolsonaro’s overseas campaign. The petition was filed by Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), citing new revelations that Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly paid Daniel Vorcaro to finance Jair Bolsonaro’s biopic. The case was reassigned to Mendonça under the principle of prevention, as he already oversees related cases involving the Master Bank.

item.title: Motta vai juntar PL do MEI a texto com impacto de R$ 50 bilhões
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced he will attach the government's bill to raise the MEI's annual revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$140,000 by 2028, allowing up to two employees, to a pending proposal with an estimated fiscal impact of R$50 billion. The executive bill was submitted as an alternative to the so-called 'fiscal bomb' of the existing proposal, which expands limits for the entire Simples Nacional. The Treasury warns the budget cannot absorb the measure.

item.title: Mulheres mais à esquerda, homens mais à direita
item.description: Women are increasingly voting to the left worldwide, but in Brazil, the conservative Michelle Bolsonaro has emerged as a key electoral asset disrupting this global trend. Her ideological profile contrasts with the rise of left-leaning female voters, complicating the 2026 race. The election reflects a growing gender divide in the Brazilian electorate.

item.title: Tarcísio destina R$ 3,45 milhões a indígenas que protegem florestas em SP
item.description: The Tarcísio de Freitas government allocated R$ 3.45 million to a state program that compensates Indigenous communities for biodiversity conservation, territorial protection, environmental restoration, fire prevention, and forest monitoring in São Paulo.

item.title: Clica e Confirma destaca lançamento do Manual do Eleitor para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE's Clica e Confirma program launched the new edition of the Voter's Manual for the 2026 elections, presented by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who described it as 'a statute of citizenship'. The guide outlines rights, duties, and guidance for exercising citizenship throughout the electoral process. The edition also features an interview on Brazil's Electoral Justice participation in international observation missions in Peru and Colombia, and highlights the ban on broadcasting programs featuring pre-candidates starting June 30.

item.title: PT muda de ideia e decide fazer a convenção de Lula no dia 2/8 em SP
item.description: The PT has decided to change the date and location of the convention that will officially nominate President Lula for re-election, moving from August 1st in Brasília to August 2nd in São Paulo. The party leadership stated that São Paulo is the political birthplace of the PT, Lula, and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, and is the country’s largest electoral college, making it strategically important for Lula’s re-election campaign.

item.title: Governo anuncia 20 medidas voltadas à agricultura familiar além de Plano Safra
item.description: The Lula government announced 20 new measures targeting family farming, integrated into the 2026/27 Family Farming Harvest Plan, focusing on rural credit, technical assistance, and cooperative strengthening. The initiatives aim to reduce rural inequalities and ensure food security for small producers. The announcement was made in Brasília on Tuesday, the 30th.

item.title: Senadora aciona PGR contra conselheiro de Flávio Bolsonaro por ataque a mulheres
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) has requested the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate blogger Paulo Figueiredo, advisor to presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), for alleged gender-based political violence, slander, and defamation against Michelle Bolsonaro and Damares Alves. Figueiredo reportedly stated that 'women vote badly for fuck's sake', especially single women, and attacked Michelle with terms like 'tigrona' and 'tchutchuca', while dismissing her speech as 'prejudiced'. He also called Damares Alves a 'clown' and 'scoundrel' for her stance on Flávio Bolsonaro's meetings with women.
